channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: "He will be a huge miss, an absolutely huge miss"
item.description: Former Armagh star and current Wicklow manager Oisin McConville believes Darragh Canavan's departure for the remainder of the Allianz Football League campaign after this weekend "is not ideal" for Malachy O'Rourke's side.

item.title: All-Ireland final whistle blower Dempsey emphasises the joy of refereeing
item.description: Ask any player, and they'll tell you that this time of year is for dreaming.

item.title: Kildare ace Beirne to miss Cavan clash after red card upheld
item.description: Kildare forward Alex Beirne is set to miss Sunday's Allianz Football League fourth round clash against Cavan due to suspension.

item.title: Con to captain Dubs for 2026
item.description: Six-time All-Ireland winner Con O'Callaghan has been named Dublin's senior football captain for the second year-in-a-row.

item.title: Hayes set to make Limerick return against Tipp
item.description: Kyle Hayes is back in Limerick's starting 15 for tomorrow's Allianz Hurling League showdown against Tipperary in Thurles.

item.title: Cork great Tompkins joins Bishopstown backroom team
item.description: Cork football legend Larry Tompkins has linked up with city side Bishopstown's management ahead of their new season.

item.title: Dolan expects Kerry to "sharpen the knife" against Dubs
item.description: Former Westmeath star Dessie Dolan expects Kerry manager Jack O'Connor to sharpen the knife for his side's Allianz League showdown against Dublin at Croke Park tomorrow evening (7pm).

item.title: Barrett to miss Cork's next two games after suspension upheld
item.description: Cork attacker Shane Barrett has had the red card he received against Tipperary in Round 3 of the Allianz Hurling League upheld by the Central Hearings Committee (CHC).

item.title: GAA on TV: Kerry set to return to Croker in bumper weekend of Allianz League action
item.description: It's an action-packed weekend of the Allianz Football and Hurling League ahead with six games available for fans to watch live.

item.title: "We're probably just now trying to look towards this year and build on last year"
item.description: She might be in her fourth season in the role, but Aghyaran St Davog's star Aoibhinn McHugh has insisted it remains a massive honour to be captain of the Tyrone ladies football team.
